<École X> is a francophone public elementary school of the <CSS full name> in <borough>. This
report describes it in three layers: the school itself, the kilometre around <its building /
the address the family would live near>, and what a three-bedroom home there costs to buy or
rent this month. It is one output of MTL-101, which works backwards from the school to the
neighbourhood.

::: {.callout-important}
## Not a ranking

Each zone metric is shown with its decile among the <N> francophone public elementary schools on
the island outside the West Island, marked [d1]{.decile-low} to [d3]{.decile-low} for the lowest
three tenths, [d4]{.decile-mid} to [d7]{.decile-mid} for the middle, and [d8]{.decile-high} to
[d10]{.decile-high} for the top three. A high decile means a high value, nothing
more, so the label says which way is favourable for a family: ▲ higher is favourable (children,
parks, stations), ▼ lower is favourable (crime, collisions, deprivation, cost), and rows with no
glyph are descriptive. On the ▲ and ▼ rows the most favourable of the compared zones is [shaded]{.best}.
The report computes no composite score, and the IMSE is a socioeconomic index of the pupils enrolled,
not a measure of academic performance.
:::

The MEQ's IMSE places the school in decile <d> for <year> (1 = most advantaged, 10 = most
disadvantaged; 8 to 10 is the official *milieu défavorisé*). It is built from the enrolled
pupils' parents' education and employment, not from test results, and it can differ from the
census figures for the residents of the zone in @tbl-people: <one sentence on whether they
agree here, and why they might not (choice program, private-school leakage)>.

::: {.callout-warning}
## What these two datasets cannot say

The city states the incident file is not official SPVM statistics; positions are moved to the
nearest intersection and 17% of incidents have no coordinates and are absent from the rates.
The collision extract ends in 2021; its last two years are pandemic years. Both are rates of
reported events, not of risk.
:::

## Listings expire

These are the 3+ bedroom listings found on <date> within about a kilometre of <the anchor>,
chosen for variety of type rather than as a sample; prices are asking prices, and the section
is not refreshed when the post is republished. For a durable benchmark use the assessed values
in @tbl-cost, which lag the market by about eighteen months.
:::

# Sources and caveats

- **School facts**: the school's site and the <CSS> pages linked in the footnotes, opened on
  <date>; <which facts are unverified and why>.
- **Community links**: searched on <date>; <which ones loaded, which are unverified, and whether
  any could not be tied to this school rather than a same-named one>.
- **IMSE/SFR**: MEQ, *Indices de défavorisation*, Données Québec, school year <year>.
- **Zone tables**: `scripts/zone_stats.py` on open data fetched between <oldest> and <newest>
  (Ville de Montréal, Données Québec, INSPQ, Statistics Canada 2021 Census); <n> dissemination
  areas by centroid; IEMV covers <x>% of residents; tax bills matched for <y>% of units. Census
  2021 is five years old; assessed values reflect the July 2024 market.
- **Listings**: as seen on <sites> on <date>.
- **Deciles**: among <N> in-scope schools, from `data/derived/zone_stats_all.parquet`.

# Conclusion

Four readings, in the order a parent weighs them. Each states what the tables show, not a verdict.

**School.** <Program, admission model, IMSE/SFR deciles with the caveat, pupils, and the
building situation: renovation, relocation, return date (@tbl-school).>

**Safety.** <Crime rate and its categories against the island, the pedestrian and cyclist line
for the 500 m walk, how the comparators differ, and the two datasets' limits (@tbl-safety).>

**Livability.** <Who lives there: children and households with children, mobility, education,
language at home; the two composite indices; parks and what lies just outside the circle;
metro access (@tbl-people, @tbl-indices, @tbl-parks).>

**Affordability.** <Housing stock mix, assessed values and tax bills by type against the island,
and what the month's listings say about three-bedroom homes to buy and to rent (@tbl-stock,
@tbl-cost, @tbl-for-sale, @tbl-for-rent).>
